title: Piyale Pasha Mosque
scope: Standing Piyale Pasha Mosque in Kasımpaşa, with six matching lead-covered domes in two rows, a central north minaret, double gallery system and the octagonal historic türbe.
limitations: The model represents the standing mosque galleries, prayer hall and extant türbe. Former medrese and dervish lodge wings are outside the represented period.
The long span and reference sections produce estimated external dimensions. Portico paving, tomb eaves and sill heights follow approximate terrain grades.
Mortar details, timber joinery, finial ornament and individual stone panels are generalized. Interior tilework and furniture are outside the model scope.
